name: Teacher as Researcher | Sustaining Literacy Routines
description: This badge recognizes your participation in a shared teacher-research cycle by preparing, teaching, and reflecting on the Layered Writing lesson sequence with colleagues.
criteria:
**To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:**

* A clear discussion of what you learned about your teaching and your students through this inquiry cycle.

* A description of one meaningful moment from teaching the lesson sequence, with an explanation of why it stands out and what it reveals about your students, the layering process, or your own instructional decision-making.

* Insights from reviewing your students’ drafts.

* Any questions you have about selecting or preparing student writing to bring to the spring meeting.

Teacher as Researcher | Sustaining Literacy Routines

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This badge recognizes your participation in a shared teacher-research cycle by preparing, teaching, and reflecting on the Layered Writing lesson sequence with colleagues.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • A clear discussion of what you learned about your teaching and your students through this inquiry cycle.

  • A description of one meaningful moment from teaching the lesson sequence, with an explanation of why it stands out and what it reveals about your students, the layering process, or your own instructional decision-making.

  • Insights from reviewing your students’ drafts.

  • Any questions you have about selecting or preparing student writing to bring to the spring meeting.
